quotes.text: The Knicks and DoorDash are bringing Popcorn TWOsday back, all season long! Ticketed fans can purchase popcorn for just $2 during all Tuesday Knicks home games this season.

Offer valid only on select popcorn boxes at participating concession stands in Madison Square Garden each Tuesday during Knicks regular season home games during the 2026-27 season. Offer applies to food item only and not to applicable taxes or other charges. Eligible game dates as follows: 10/20/26, 10/27/26, 11/20/26, 1/26/27, 2/9/27, 3/2/27 and 3/23/27.

The one promotion they list is Popcorn TWOsday with DoorDash: $2 popcorn for ticketed fans at every Tuesday home game this season. We will add giveaways and theme nights here when the team announces them.
notes: Firecrawl calls: 8 of 10 allowed, 8 credits of 50 (1 credit each; map responses did not return creditsUsed, counted as 1 each). Popcorn TWOsday is a food deal, not a giveaway; if the pipeline's promo types exclude food deals, the label would drop to GENUINELY-NONE for giveaways and theme nights.
